summary: Lists DHCP option codes that were assigned to proposed options which were never used, and directs IANA to make them available for assignment to other options. It also lists several codes not currently documented in an RFC. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A coat rack has hooks that nobody uses. This document says which hooks are empty, so they can be given to new coats instead of staying wasted.

questions: which dhcp option codes are free
